content.text:
I found nine claims in the overview. Eight are supported by the record and one is flagged.

**Flagged:** "Nobody was paged, so no one had to respond out of hours." That nobody was paged is supported: no on-call incident was linked, so no engineer time was spent at all. The record says nothing about working hours, though. The incident ran from 12:17 to 12:25 UTC, which isn't obviously outside working hours. This one is a judgement call, because the sentence is literally true if nobody responded at all. I flagged it anyway because it suggests a cost that was avoided, and the record doesn't show that.

**Supported:** who was affected, the worst-minute failure rate, the cause, the update stopping partway, the estimated lost takings, the rollback ending the incident and Argus confirming it, the rollback staying in place, and automatic sync being left off. Figures in braces weren't judged, as the ask says.

flags.why: The record says only that nobody was paged and no engineer time was spent; it says nothing about working hours, and the incident ran at 12:17–12:25 UTC.
